privacy_text_unsupported.message: This text cannot be filtered safely. Edit the input or start a new prompt; restarting Thunderbird will not resolve this text-specific error.
privacy_text_unsupported.description: A deterministic tokenizer alignment, chunking or reserved-placeholder error.

privacy_unrestored_placeholder.message: The AI changed a privacy placeholder. The response was blocked instead of inserting an incomplete or incorrectly restored result. Regenerate the response or start a new prompt.
privacy_unrestored_placeholder.description: Blocking error when a response still contains a changed or unknown placeholder from the current conversation.

privacy_invalid_json.message: Privacy processing blocked invalid JSON in the provider configuration. Correct the extra-body, options or schema JSON before retrying.

privacy_identifier_key_invalid.message: The local privacy identifier key is invalid. Privacy processing was blocked; restore the companion's local storage before retrying.

privacy_web_input_title.message: Additional text for your AI prompt

privacy_web_local_notice.message: This is a ThunderAI Privacy extension window. Original values and locally restored answers are not written back into the provider's website or conversation. Detection can still miss personal data.

privacy_intro.message: Mask personal data locally before AI requests and restore it in the response. Detection is best-effort.

privacy_enabled.message: Privacy filtering is enabled. Changes apply to new chats and commands.

privacy_description.message: Masks detected personal data locally for ThunderAI prompts, follow-ups and automatic features, including provider instructions. Long inputs use overlapping chunks of up to 2048 model tokens, then one complete masked request. Detection can miss data, including across chunk boundaries. Provider context limits still apply. ChatGPT Web stays masked; view restored results in an extension window or use Thunderbird's reply/replace actions. Direct typing into ChatGPT, existing conversations and project/custom-GPT content are not filtered.

privacy_enable.message: Enable privacy filtering for all ThunderAI features

privacy_cancelled.message: Privacy filtering cancelled. Nothing was sent by this operation.

privacy_size_unknown.message: Check status to retrieve model metadata

privacy_delete_confirm.message: Delete this privacy model and free its disk space? Active privacy sessions will be closed. Filtering will block requests until you download the model again or explicitly disable filtering.

privacy_deleted.message: Model deleted. Download it again before using privacy filtering.

privacy_download_required.message: Download the complete privacy model in ThunderAI Privacy settings before enabling or using it. WebGPU and WASM use the same fp16 model files.

privacy_downloaded.message: Privacy model downloaded and ready to enable.

privacy_backend_wasm.message: WASM · fp16 weights, fp32 computation (CPU fallback)

privacy_permission_required.message: Permission to access Hugging Face model downloads is required.

privacy_platform_unsupported.message: This model requires a supported 64-bit Thunderbird build (x86-64 or ARM64). 32-bit builds are not supported. No model was loaded.

privacy_main_unavailable.message: Install or enable a compatible ThunderAI with processing API v1 support before enabling privacy filtering.

privacy_session_expired.message: The privacy session has expired or the companion restarted. Start a new ThunderAI chat or command.

privacy_invalid_request.message: ThunderAI sent an invalid processing request. Update both add-ons together.

privacy_memory_error.message: The local privacy model ran out of memory. Close other applications, restart Thunderbird and try a smaller input.

privacy_inference_error.message: Local privacy processing failed. Nothing was sent by this operation. Retry after restarting Thunderbird; check the model download and enable diagnostics for details.

privacy_extra_body_key_unsupported.message: Privacy filtering blocked a detected personal value in an API/schema key. Remove that key or move the value to a supported text/metadata field.

privacy_extra_body_key_collision.message: Privacy filtering would create duplicate extra-body keys. Change that configuration before retrying.

privacy_log.message: Temporarily log requests, placeholder mappings and responses

privacy_log_warning.message: Logs prepared hook content, placeholder mappings including original private values, local progress/errors, and responses before restoration—not actual provider HTTP requests. Logs contain sensitive data. Use fictional messages and review logs before sharing. Changes apply to new chats.

extensionDescription.message: ThunderAI Privacy is a Thunderbird add-on, designed to add privacy features to ThunderAI.

prefsInfoDesc_1.message: ThunderAI Privacy is a companion add-on for Thunderbird, designed to add privacy features to ThunderAI. To use this add-on you need to install ThunderAI.

prefsInfoDesc_2.message: Get ThunderAI from the Thunderbird Add-ons page!
